Estimate the pollinator contribution per outcome

Source: R/contribution.R
pollin_contribution.Rd

Fits, for each outcome, a generalised linear mixed model with the pollination treatment as the fixed effect of interest and the random structure of the design (pollin_fit()), then reports the contribution as a model-based average treatment effect, the reference-minus-exclusion difference in expected response, with propagated uncertainty, via G-computation (pollin_effects()). A random treatment slope, where the design carries one, absorbs unobserved between-unit heterogeneity in the contribution (for example an unrecorded genotype). Family is chosen per outcome from its values unless supplied.

Usage

pollin_contribution(x, outcomes = NULL, by = NULL, families = list(), ...)

Arguments

x

A pollin_estimand() object with family = "dependence" and scale = "difference".

outcomes

Outcomes to model. NULL (the default) models every response.

by

Optional name of a column for conditional contrasts, one per level (for example a region).

families

Optional named list of glmmTMB family objects, one per outcome; outcomes it does not name are chosen from their values.

...

Passed to glmmTMB::glmmTMB().

Value

An object of class pollin_contribution: a list with table (a tidy data frame of contrasts with FDR-adjusted p-values and the standard deviation of the random treatment slope) and fits (the fitted models, for diagnostics). From an estimand, table carries the columns of pollin_effects(), and the list also holds the estimand.

Details

The treatment effect is causal by design here – the exclusion contrast is an experimental manipulation – so no covariate adjustment is applied; see pollin_moderation() for the observational "which insects" question.

Examples

# \donttest{
set.seed(1)
d <- data.frame(
  trt = rep(rep(c("Cage", "Open"), each = 10L), 8L),
  Site = rep(paste0("s", seq_len(8L)), each = 20L)
)
d$pods <- rnbinom(nrow(d), mu = exp(3 + 0.3 * (d$trt == "Open")), size = 10)
pd <- pollin_data(d, "pods", "trt", unit = "Site")
ds <- pollin_design(pd, c(excluded = "Cage", open = "Open"), "rcbd")
est <- pollin_estimand(ds, "dependence", "difference", "loss")
pollin_contribution(est)
#> <pollin_contribution>  (open - exclusion, model-based ATE)
#>  response     contrast estimate std.error conf.low conf.high      p.value
#>      pods Open vs Cage   7.3875  1.436307  4.57239  10.20261 2.698127e-07
#>      family      scale basis distribution interval slope_sd        p.fdr
#>  dependence difference  loss      nbinom2    delta       NA 2.698127e-07
# }
